Title: Public Preview: Azure Chaos Studio has Query-Based Dynamic Targets

Body.Content:
The Query-Based Dynamic Targets feature allows Chaos Studio users to select fault targets by inputting a KQL query to be executed at experiment execution time. All resources onboarded to Chaos Studio at experiment execution time that match the query result set will be targeted by the selected fault. Read more on Target selection in Azure Chaos Studio Preview | Microsoft Learn. 

For more information about Azure Chaos Studio, see Azure Chaos Studio documentation.
